ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the source report was ingested into the system

reportName.description: Name of the source EDRS report file the record was extracted from

reportFolder.description: Source folder or path where the report file was collected

link_session_id.description: EDRS link session identifier from the LINK SESSIONS DETAILS column

geo_satellite_id.description: Identifier of the geostationary EDRS relay satellite used for the link

satellite_id.description: Identifier of the LEO satellite that performed the acquisition

mission.description: Mission code derived from the first two characters of the satellite identifier

doy.description: Day of year of the link session as reported in the EDRS report

planned_link_session_start.description: Planned start time of the EDRS link session, computed from the report base date and day of year

planned_link_session_stop.description: Planned stop time of the EDRS link session, computed from the report base date and day of year

moc_accept_status.description: MOC acceptance status of the link session

uplink_status.description: Uplink status of the link session

spacecraft_execution.description: Spacecraft execution status of the link session

edte_acquisition_status.description: EDTE acquisition status of the link session

dcsu_archive_status.description: DCSU archive status of the link session

sfdap_dissem_status.description: SFDAP dissemination status of the link session

total_status.description: Overall status of the link session

ground_station.description: Ground station that disseminated the acquired data

dissemination_start.description: Start time of data dissemination from the ground station

dissemination_stop.description: Stop time of data dissemination from the ground station

cadus.description: Number of CADUs disseminated for the link session

fer.description: Frame Error Rate reported for the link session

archived_data_size.description: Size of the archived data for the link session

disseminated_data.description: Volume of data disseminated for the link session

notes.description: Free-text notes from the EDRS report

interface_name.description: Name of the collector interface that produced this record, set to Jira_EDRS

production_service_type.description: Type of the production service that provided the report, set to EDRS

production_service_name.description: Name of the production service that provided the report, set to EDRS-Operations

report_type.description: Reporting period derived from the report file name (daily for DOR, weekly for WOR, monthly for MOR)
